_schema.note: First real slice of the feature-mechanics catalog project (started 2026-09-24, see engine/CHECKLIST.md) -- a real single source of truth for a feature's mechanical facts (action_type/recharge/uses_max/per_turn_cap), keyed by the SAME id classFeatures.js/subclasses.js already reference in features_by_level. Deliberately incremental: only entries actually needed so far are here, not the whole 1221-entry feature-catalog.json. diffLevelUp.js falls back to today's bare-grant behavior for anything not yet listed here -- an uncataloged feature isn't an error, just not-yet-migrated.

fields.action_type: 'action'|'bonus_action'|'reaction'|'free', omitted entirely for a passive/no-action feature (never null -- matches the existing character-data convention audited into consistency 2026-09-23).
fields.recharge: 'short_rest'|'long_rest', omitted for an at-will or non-pool feature.
fields.uses_max: A flat number, OR omitted for a feature with no numeric pool (e.g. Sneak Attack -- unlimited attempts, gated only by per_turn_cap below). Mutually exclusive with uses_formula below -- a feature has at most one of the two.
fields.uses_formula: Present instead of uses_max when the pool size genuinely depends on character state (RAW itself says so -- this is never used just because a number is inconvenient to type twice). Resolved against the character in diffLevelUp.js's applyFeatureMechanics, NOT stored as a formula on the character record -- only the resolved number lands in uses_max/uses_current there. Two shapes exist so far, added only when a real feature needed them (see engine/CHECKLIST.md's 2026-09-24 entry -- deliberately not a general expression language): {type:'ability_mod', ability:'cha'|'str'|..., base:1, min?:1} resolves to base + that ability's modifier (Divine Sense: 1 + CHA mod), clamped up to `min` ONLY when that key is present, and {type:'level_multiple', class:'Paladin', multiplier:5} resolves to that NAMED class's own level (not total character level) times multiplier (Lay on Hands: paladin level x 5). A resolved value can legitimately come out to 0 or negative (a very-low-CHA Paladin really does get 0 uses of Divine Sense per RAW) -- never floored to 1 silently UNLESS RAW itself states an explicit minimum (Bardic Inspiration: 'a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (a minimum of once)' -- `min: 1` models exactly that stated floor, opt-in per feature so it's never applied where RAW doesn't actually say so).
fields.per_turn_cap: true if this feature can only be used/apply once per the character's own turn, REGARDLESS of how large its uses_max pool is (Action Surge 17th, Sneak Attack). This is a genuinely separate axis from uses_max/recharge -- see engine/CHECKLIST.md's 2026-09-24 entry for why. Tracked as ephemeral per-combat state (combatTurn.js), never on the persisted character record, since it only has meaning inside an active encounter.
fields.tier_family: Present only on a feature that's granted at multiple levels as successive SRD-style tiered ids (action-surge-1-use -> action-surge-2-uses, indomitable-1-use -> -2-uses -> -3-uses). diffLevelUp.js uses this to MERGE a later tier into the character's existing single tile (bumping uses_max) instead of adding a second duplicate feature entry -- see diffLevelUp.js's own comment on this block. All ids sharing a tier_family MUST share the same display name.
fields.adds_ability_to_initiative: An ability key ('int'), present on a feature that adds that ability's modifier to initiative on top of DEX (Chronurgy Magic's Temporal Awareness). Carried onto the character's feature record by applyFeatureMechanics (fill-only-if-missing, like the other fields) and read by checks.js's initiative(), which counts each ability once and uses the EFFECTIVE score. Added 2026-10-06.
fields.grants_spells: Present on a feature that teaches a specific spell as an always-prepared/always-known bonus that does NOT count against the character's normal known/prepared totals -- same semantics as feats.json's own grants_spells.fixed, added here 2026-09-26 for the class/subclass-feature side of that same gap (found on Circle of Stars' Star Map: 'you have the Guiding Bolt spell prepared at all times -- it doesn't count against your number of spells known', TODO.md 2026-09-22). Shape so far: {fixed: [spellName, ...]} -- only ever a flat list, no choice/tiered variant needed yet. Applied in diffLevelUp.js's applyFeatureMechanics with the SAME fill-only-if-missing rule as every other field here (job 4): writes feature.spells_granted only when the feature doesn't already have one, so a hand-fixed character record (Tackett's Star Map already carries a manually-set spells_granted) is never silently overwritten. Consumed by spellUtils.js exactly like any other features[].spells_granted entry -- see that file's step 3. Deliberately does NOT (yet) model a spell that's ALSO castable without expending a slot off some other resource formula -- Star Map's real RAW additionally lets you cast Guiding Bolt free a number of times equal to proficiency bonus per long rest, which this catalog doesn't capture: that would need a per-spell uses_max/recharge tracked and recomputed the same live way this file's uses_formula fields already are, and today nothing here does that for a SPELL entry (only for a FEATURE entry). Deferred until a second real feature needs the same shape, per this catalog's own deliberately-incremental philosophy -- see engine/CHECKLIST.md's 2026-09-26 entry.
fields.grants_resistance: Damage types the feature gives Resistance to (['fire']). Read by featureGrants.js characterGrants, derived for the sheet every time, never stored. `grants_resistance_from_lineage: true` means the type comes from the species lineage table (Dragonborn ancestry). Added 2026-11-04 (the owner's rule: nothing functional lives only in text).
fields.grants_saving_throw_advantage: What a saving-throw advantage is against, as a token ('being_charmed', 'being_frightened', 'being_poisoned', 'illusions', 'paralysis', 'intelligence_saves'). Derived by characterGrants; the sheet shows it as a fact (advantage is rolled at the table). Added 2026-11-04.
fields.grants_skill_advantage: Skill advantage: a plain skill name is unconditional (it also counts toward passive checks, checks.js), an object { skill, when } is advantage only in the stated case (Sharp Nose: Perception, checks that rely on smell) and never changes a passive score. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.grants_check_advantage: Ability-check advantage that is not a skill: [{ when: 'to end the Grappled condition' }]. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.grants_darkvision: Darkvision range in feet. The sheet's darkvision is the largest of the character's own field, its features and its lineage. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.grants_skill_proficiency: Skills the feature gives outright, applied to skill_proficiencies once when the feature is gained (creation and level-up both do). A skill already held is replaced by a pick of the player's. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.grants_skill_proficiency_choice: { count, options: [skill names] | 'any' }: skills the player picks when the feature is gained (Bladesinger's Training in War and Song). A choice in the choice protocol (type featureGrantChoice). Added 2026-11-04.
fields.grants_weapon_proficiency: Weapons the feature gives proficiency with: names ('rapier') or { filter: { category, kind, lacks: [property] } } expanded against the weapon table when the feature is gained (Bladesinger: martial melee without Two-Handed or Heavy). Added 2026-11-04.
fields.grants_armor_proficiency: Armor categories the feature gives training in, applied once when gained. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.grants_tool_proficiency: Tools the feature gives proficiency with, applied once when gained. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.size_counts_as_larger: What the character counts as one size larger for: 'carrying_capacity', 'grappling' (Powerful Build, Catrin's Broad Build). Read by speciesRules.js effectiveSize. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.reaction_effect: The effect of a reaction the engine can compute: { trigger, damage_fraction, push: { feet, max_size } } (Catrin's Brace). Read by speciesRules.js braceOutcome. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.moves_through_creature_space: { min_size, squeezing } the character may move through a creature's space of that size or larger without squeezing (Drevani's Low Profile). Read by speciesRules.js. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.unarmed_attack: An attack the feature makes with the body: { damage_type, ability, dice_by_level } (Drevani's Ferocious Bite). Read by unarmedAttacks.js ferociousBite; its once-per-rest use is the entry's own uses/recharge. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.on_use: What using the feature DOES, as a list of effects the engine resolves (featureUse.js useFeature): heal {dice}, temp_hp {amount}, action {action}, damage {dice, type, trigger}, area_save {ability, dc, shapes|radius_feet, damage, on_success|on_failure}, reduce_damage {dice, plus_ability}, teleport {feet}, condition {condition}, speed_reduction {feet}. Amounts: a number, {type:"proficiency_bonus"}, {type:"by_level", table}, {type:"ability_mod", ability}; dice: {count: amount, sides}; a DC is {type:"dc", ability} = 8 + ability modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.min_level: Total character level at which the feature can first be used (Celestial Revelation 3, Draconic Flight and Large Form 5). Added 2026-11-04.
fields.active: { duration_minutes, choose_one_of: [feature ids], extra_damage, ends_on, requires }: using the feature starts a temporary state, recorded in the character's active_effects and ended by the player or by a rest. While it lasts the active_grants apply (featureGrants.js characterGrants). Added 2026-11-04.
fields.active_grants: { fly_speed: "speed", tremorsense, light, size, speed_bonus, check_advantage }: what the character has while the feature's temporary state lasts. Read only while the feature is in active_effects. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.option_of: Marks a feature as one of the choices of another feature (Heavenly Wings is a form of Celestial Revelation). Added 2026-11-04.
fields.extra_damage_type: The damage type of the active state's extra damage (Celestial Revelation: radiant, or necrotic for Necrotic Shroud). Added 2026-11-04.
fields.aura: { timing, radius_feet, damage: { amount, type } }: damage a temporary state deals to creatures nearby (Inner Radiance). Added 2026-11-04.
fields.d20_reroll_on: Natural d20 results the character may reroll on a D20 Test, keeping the new die (Halfling Luck: [1]). Read by characterGrants as d20RerollOn and by d20Test.rollD20Test. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.hide_obscured_by: { size_delta }: the character can Hide when obscured only by a creature at least this many sizes larger (Naturally Stealthy: 1). Read by speciesRules.canHideBehind. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.on_long_rest: { heroic_inspiration: true }: what finishing a Long Rest gives the character (Human Resourceful). Read by rest.applyLongRest. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.survives_at_hp: Hit points the character drops to instead of 0 when damage would not kill outright, once per use of the feature (Orc Relentless Endurance: 1). Read by speciesRules.applyDamageWithSurvival. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.grants_hp_per_level: Maximum hit points per character level the feature adds, retroactively (Dwarven Toughness: 1). The species data carries the same number for the level-up path; a test keeps them equal. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.grants_condition_immunity: Conditions or effects the character cannot suffer ("magical_sleep" for Elf Trance). Read by characterGrants as conditionImmunities. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.needs_sleep: false for a character that does not need to sleep (Elf Trance). Read by characterGrants. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.long_rest_hours: How many hours a Long Rest takes the character (Elf Trance: 4). Read by rest.longRestHours. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.grants_speed: A walking Speed the lineage sets (Wood Elf: 35). Mirrors the lineage table's speed. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.creates_objects: { kind, max, ac, hp, via, activation, lasts_hours }: objects the character can have in existence at once (Rock Gnome's clockwork devices). Read by speciesRules.createObject. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.cantrip_swap: { replaces, from_list, when }: the lineage cantrip may be replaced by another from a class list after a Long Rest (High Elf). Read by lineageSpells.swapLineageCantrip. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.lineage_damage: The damage type a lineage pick gives (a Dragonborn ancestry's Breath Weapon and resistance). Added 2026-11-04.
fields.pick: true: the feature is a choice made when the character is created (a lineage, an ancestry, a skill), recorded as a feature of its own and in species-choices.json; the effect of each option is on that option's entry. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.narrative: true plus a reason: the feature has nothing a rule can compute. Reviewed, not forgotten. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.engine_rule: For a feature whose rule is bespoke engine code rather than a structured field: "rules/5e/<file>.js#<exportedFunction>" (Sneak Attack dice, Rage damage...). engine/test/featureRulesRatchet.test.js checks the file exports that function. Added 2026-11-04.
fields.crit_extra_dice: { attack: 'melee_weapon', dice }: extra weapon damage dice on a critical hit with that kind of attack (Half-Orc Savage Attacks: 1). Read by weaponAttack.criticalDamageDice. Added 2026-11-04.
